response.rationale: All six cited items are positive and none are negative, including a T1 meta-analysis (li-2016) showing aptitude correlates with L2 proficiency, plus T4 studies (dekeyser-2000, abrahamsson-2008) and a T6 review (hyltenstam-2016) that tie high aptitude to late learners reaching native-like levels, while the T3 working-memory and executive-control items (festman-2010, biedron-2012) only indirectly support it, and the evidence suggests aptitude matters most for late learners rather than for everyone.
